name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance. Due to time constraints, solo and duo performances are encouraged to perform at the Los Alamitos Variety Show on March 20th (sign up by March 1st).

name: Variety Show - Volunteers & Important Info
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands to assist performers and Concession Organizer to coordinate snacks and sales. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To Apply to the Variety Show, share your talent - sing, rap, dance, lip sync, magic, musical instrument, cheer performance, skit, monologue, jump rope, yo yo, puppet show, comedy routine, impressions, mime, martial arts demo, poetry, baton twirling.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest (5th Graders Only)
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel. Submit art on an 8.5 X 11 sheet of white paper, using the paper vertically. The entry must include the theme 'Under the Sea', the words 'Los Alamitos', and the School Year '2025-2026'.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos for Yearbook
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages in the yearbook! They are due by March 31st. Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: NOWRUZ (IRANIAN NEW YEAR) STAFF LUNCHEON
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th grade parents
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: PTA Board Members Needed for 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! Serving on the PTA Executive Board offers a behind-the-scenes look at how our fundraising efforts work and provides a direct way to support and strengthen our school community.

name: Yearbook Photos Needed
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, or the Dances, please upload to the designated Google Drive folders. Please only upload 1-2 photos per event.

name: Yearbook Order Deadline
description: Order your 2025–26 Yearbook today and save all the memories. Last day to order is April 20th — but don't wait until the last minute! We won't have extras on hand if you forget to order.
